falseCreditGateComparison.calibrated: doc-a::VI::6.10-chapeau correctly rejected by the new second-pass reviewer under the new protocol - a genuine, demonstrated fix to the specific failure mode Phase 3F.1.5's forensics identified as most concerning.

netAssessment: The calibration effort had mixed but real results: it fixed the specific false-credit-reproduction risk it targeted (concrete, demonstrated), and it modestly improved binary agreement (concrete, demonstrated, +9 points) - but it did not close either pre-registered gate, and it surfaced a new, more granular category of disagreement (the safe-surfacing threshold gap, 31 of 39 detailed disagreements) that Phase 3F.1.5's original, coarser protocol was structurally unable to reveal. This is consistent with the phase charter's own Section 16 expectation that a more honest, more granular measurement can surface MORE disagreement, not less, and that this is a sign of validity, not failure, of the measurement approach - even though it means the phase's own PASS gate is not met.
